title: Shawarma Chicken Rice Bowls
seoTitle: Shawarma Chicken Rice Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Sheet-pan spiced chicken with turmeric rice and cucumber yogurt
subtitle: Sheet-pan spiced chicken with turmeric rice and cucumber yogurt
description: Chicken thighs roast with shawarma spices on sheet pans, served over turmeric rice with cucumber yogurt, tomatoes, and pickled onions.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Shawarma Chicken Rice Bowls in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Marinate chicken
steps.instruction: Toss thighs with half the olive oil, cumin, coriander, paprika, half the garlic, and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Marinate at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cook turmeric rice
steps.instruction: Cook basmati with a pinch of turmeric and salt until fluffy. Grains should be separate and lightly golden, not clumped or wet. Plan about 20 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Roast chicken
steps.instruction: Roast marinated thighs at 425°F on two sheet pans 22–28 minutes until charred at edges and internal temp hits 165°F. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Make cucumber yogurt
steps.instruction: Mix yogurt, grated drained cucumber, remaining garlic, 2 tbsp lemon juice, and salt until creamy with no watery separation. Keep finished cold items below 41°F if they sit more than 30 minutes — nest the hotel pan on ice at the line. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Portion and open the line
steps.instruction: Portion Shawarma Chicken Rice Bowls onto sheet trays or hotel pans for family-style service. Stack plates, forks, and napkins at the end of the line so late-arriving crew can self-serve without bottlenecking the cook.

steps.title: Scale for larger halls
steps.instruction: When cooking for more than 8 firefighters, split into two pans halfway through so the bottom layer does not overcook while the top waits — duplicate mise en place if you double batches.

steps.title: Build bowls
steps.instruction: Slice chicken and portion over rice with tomatoes and pickled onion. Drizzle yogurt. Chicken should be juicy with crisp spice crust.

proTips: Drain grated cucumber or yogurt sauce turns watery at the line.
Quick-pickle onion in vinegar 15 minutes if you forgot overnight prep.
Offer harissa paste for crews who want extra heat.
tonightSpread: Hummus with olive oil and paprika.
leftovers: Shawarma wrap with leftover chicken and extra yogurt.
Rice and chicken salad bowl with lemon dressing.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Big flavor profile without a vertical rotisserie. Bowls travel well for crew eating at different times.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate chicken up to 24 hours. Pickle onions overnight for best tang. Station: Roast chicken on two pans with space between thighs for even char. Station: Keep cucumber yogurt chilled on ice at the line—it balances hot chicken. Station: Bowl assembly: rice, sliced chicken, tomato, onion, yogurt drizzle, parsley.
